_comment: Shared mutation-testing config. Run it per package via `pnpm test:mutation <package-dir>` (scripts/mutation.mjs), which sets cwd to that package so the relative globs below resolve inside it. Opt-in and NOT a CI gate: the per-entity mutator loop is the always-on discipline, this is the periodic audit that catches tests which rotted after the entity was written. NOTE: `*.test-d.ts` (vitest TYPE tests, run only under --typecheck) must be excluded like `*.test.ts` — Stryker otherwise mutates them, and every such mutant reports NoCoverage because the normal run never executes them. In @bugsee/protocol that was 178 mutants dragging the score down ~20 points, hiding the real picture. The vitest coverage config excludes them for the same reason.
